title: "The R Statistical Language"
subtitle: "From the base-R console to tidyverse & ggplot2"

This **introductory / comprehensive** course on R is taught from the base-R
console in Positron, progressively moving into the tidyverse and ggplot2. It
runs over three 3-hour sessions, each pairing slide decks with hands-on labs
and live-coding.

## Synopsis

|                          |  |
| ------------------------ | - |
| Professor                | Aymeric STAMM (CNRS & ENSAI) |
| ECTS Credits             | 0 (preliminary course) |
| Lectures and Tutorials   | 9 hrs (ENSAI) |
| Estimated personal workload (beyond lecture and tutorial time) | ~1–2 hrs per session: working through the un-solved lab scripts and the cheeky "Your turn" tasks scattered through the decks. |
| Teaching language        | English |
| Software & Packages      | R, Positron (edition/render), base R + the **tidyverse** (dplyr, tidyr, stringr) and **ggplot2**. |
| Teaching materials       | Per-session [slide decks](#subjects-covered) and matching **`lab-*.R` scripts**, downloadable below; the shared `penguins.csv` / `penguins_messy.txt` data ships alongside each lab. |

## Learning Outcomes

By the end of this course you will be able to:

- Work comfortably from the base-R console in Positron: use R as a calculator, know the core data types and special values, and read/write data.
- Build and subset **vectors**, **lists** and **data frames / tibbles**, and choose the right structure for a task.
- Transform data with the **tidyverse**, the `|>` pipe, `filter()`/`select()`/`mutate()`/`arrange()`/`group_by()`/`summarise()`, and tidying with `pivot_longer()`/`pivot_wider()`.
- Repeat work with **loops**, the `*apply()` family, and your own **functions**, using base-R grouped summaries (`tapply()`, `aggregate()`).
- Explore data with base-R plotting and produce polished figures with **ggplot2** (layers, facets, histograms, scatter plots, boxplots).

## Prerequisites

Nothing beyond R itself and the Positron IDE. Beginners and experts alike can
start at Session 1; advanced students can skim the foundations and pick up at
the tidyverse in Session 2.

## Subjects Covered

| Session | Deck & labs | Subjects |
| ------- | ----------- | -------- |
| 1 · [Foundations: vectors to tables](session-1/session-1.qmd) — [lab 1](session-1/lab-1-vectors.R) · [lab 2](session-1/lab-2-dataframes.R) | What is R and why use it; setting up your environment; the console, scripts and R as a calculator; **vectors** and subsetting; **lists**; **data frames / tibbles**; reading and writing data. |
| 2 · [Explore your data: the tidyverse](session-2/session-2.qmd) — [lab 1](session-2/lab-1-tidyverse.R) · [lab 2](session-2/lab-2-plotting.R) | The `|>` pipe; **dplyr** transforms (`filter`, `select`, `mutate`, `arrange`, `group_by`, `summarise`); **tidyr** (pivot longer/wider); **stringr**; base-R plotting; **ggplot2** (layers, facets, hists/scatters/boxplots, `fct_reorder`). |
| 3 · [Repeat & package: loops, matrices, functions](session-3/session-3.qmd) — [lab 1](session-3/lab-1-loops.R) · [lab 2](session-3/lab-2-matrices.R) · [lab 3](session-3/lab-3-functions.R) | `for`/`while`/`if`/`else` (preallocation, vectorization); the `*apply()` family; base-R grouped summaries; **matrices** (arithmetic, `%*%`, `solve()`, `apply()`, `sweep()`); custom **functions**. |
